transcript.text: Maria, we are expanding our operations to support clients across Asia. We need connectivity that respects different regulatory requirements in each country.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I appreciate you considering us for this expansion. Cross-border compliance is indeed complex. We have established partnerships in Singapore, Hong Kong, and Tokyo specifically to navigate local regulations properly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Excellent. We also need to consider time zone support. Our trading happens around the clock.

transcript.speaker: Agent
